newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia GDP growth at 8.4 pct in Q2--Bank Negara.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia GDP growth at 8.4 pct in Q2--Bank Negara.

text.p: Malaysia's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 8.4 percent year-on-year in the second quarter compared with 8.3 percent in the previous three months, the central bank said on Monday.
The GDP growth was much slower than the 9.6 percent recorded in the second quarter of 1995, Bank Negara said in its quarterly statement on economic and financial developments.
